read_only_static_findings.fact: worker_handler fixture yields a WorkerAPILogHandler without attaching it; failing test does not request logger fixture that explicitly attaches and sets DEBUG.
WorkerAPILogHandler.emit returns early if record.worker_id is missing or determine_server_type()!=CLOUD.
determine_server_type directly compares current API URL prefix to current Cloud API URL; no cache decorator or memoized server type in this function.
APILogHandler.emit also respects logging.to_api.enabled and record.send_to_api before prepare.
_api_log_sink is process-global. emit_api_log synchronously calls custom sink when non-None, otherwise APILogWorker.instance().send synchronously.
Explicit overridden-sink test resets sink to None in finally; this static path does not itself establish a leak.
